/// WHAT WE HAVE

Our Facilities

Max Gloves BD Ltd. is based in Savar, Hemayetpur, Bangladesh, in a prime manufacturing area only 1 hour outside the capital Dhaka, and the airport. Further benefits of our location include convenient transport links to the nearest port, Chittagong.

Bangladesh has the second largest garment manufacturing industry behind China. This enables Max Gloves BD Ltd. to hire experienced workers that are efficient, organized, and flexible.

Max Gloves BD Ltd. produces reliable leather drivers and welding gloves that are shipped to global clients across the world.

We create advanced leather gloves with increased comfort and heat resistance. Our team can develop custom products based on customer requirements.

We are capable of producing high volume stock at a lower cost while maintaining quality, safety, and consistent production capability.

🏅 Premium QualityHigh quality raw materials and strict quality control.
👥 Skilled WorkforceExperienced and efficient team ensuring excellence.
🏭 High CapacityLarge scale production with on-time delivery.
🛡 Safety FirstCommitted to safety standards and compliance.

Max Gloves BD Ltd. — Protecting Hands, Building Futures. Dedicated to delivering absolute quality safety and leather protective equipment.
